(2) The camera stays focused on her as she looks directly at the lens, her facial expressions shifting from neutral to slightly puzzled and then to a wide, gap-toothed smile as she engages in an off-camera conversation. (5) Multiple jump cuts repeat the visual of her laughing and playfully covering her mouth with her hand. Animated shocked-face emojis are overlaid on her torso. The male voice continues the riddle with a rising, playful pitch. (4) The female voice speaks again, sounding contemplative. A brief, comedic 'clown-horn' or slide-whistle sound effect plays as she delivers the punchline. (5) Immediately following the punchline, a loud, high-tempo EDM track with a heavy synthesized kick drum and bright lead synth lines explodes into the mix.
